<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex020022026-09-1511-35-44" status="unreviewed"><lb n="56b3"/> gsum pa la gnyis |bsgyur rten paN+Dita | bsgyur mkhan lo tsA ba| 
         dang po ni | gnas dpal ldan kha che'i grong khyer dpe med kyi| gang zag mkhas pa chen po paN+Di ta sa na sasnga na ste lnga rig dam pa'i skye bo de dang zhes pa'o| |
         gnyis pa ni | gang zag lo tsA ba <lb n="66b4"/> ste <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">'jig rten mig gyur shAkya'i dge slong blo ldan shes rab</rs> de nyid kyis | gnas grong khyer dpe med de nyid du chos 'di rgya skad las bod skad du bsgyur pa'o ||
         de ltar <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog</rs> 'gyur gzhir byas shing de las 'gyur mi bde ba rnams <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6340">nag tsho</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3868">pa tshab</rs> <lb n="66b5"/> la sogs pa'i 'gyur gzhan bde ba rnams dang don mthun par byas te | 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3780">slob dpon chos mchog</rs> gis | 
         <quote>mang la grags na dge zhes 'jig rten dag na smras pa 'di yod ste || 
         de yang med pa nyid du gsal bar rtogs na smra ba dmad pa'i gnas (smad pa'i gnas) nyid yin || </quote><!--PVinT, introductory verse--> zhes pa <lb n="56b6"/>  ltar 'dir 'thad par bsams pa'i phyir dang | don gyi (ngo bo) go rim tshig gi tshag grangs bshad grangs sogs 'gyur bde ba la bltas pa'i phyir ro || (zhes kyang nges so ||)</seg></TEI>
source: 1_020_02 dGe 'dun 'od zer_rgyud bla rnam bshad snying po.xml
